title: How a merge to production publishes
context: npm versions come from changesets. Composer releases are git tags read by Packagist. The repo shares vX.Y.Z tags between both (TD-17).

options.label: Run changeset version on main before merging; production publishes the package.json version to npm if not yet published, then tags vX.Y.Z (composer release)
Production runs changeset version itself, commits the bump back, publishes and tags

rationale: Developer chose to version on main; production only publishes and tags
